hero_bio: I design interfaces and then build them, from research and Figma to frontend code and ESP32 boards. Final-year Multimedia Communication & Design student at CIT Kokrajhar, freelancing in UI/UX and frontend.
about_lead: A final-year Multimedia Communication & Design student at CIT Kokrajhar, Assam, and a freelance designer and developer.
